data.body: Fixed by 9ac2's guard (commit 76ab5cebd2, 'fail closed on unreachable caplog assertions'), landed via epic 2f4c child 9ac2. AC evidence: (1) order-repro — pytester oracle in tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py: test_without_the_guard_the_void_assertion_passes_vacuously (pre-fix vacuous pass) + test_with_the_guard_the_void_assertion_is_failed_and_named (post-fix fail-closed naming the culprit), with deterministic poisoner fixtures. (2) state restoration — autouse _rebar_log_propagation_guard (tests/conftest.py:493) restores propagation + baseline level per test; isolation regressions test_the_guard_does_not_cascade_onto_an_innocent_later_test + test_restore_level_reports_whether_it_moved. (3) verified locally: test_agent_call_seam.py 12 passed alone; 23 passed after the integrity suite; full non-integration suite green on main CI since 76ab5cebd2. (4) make lint + typecheck clean this session. RCA on this ticket. Siblings noted in RCA (intermediates/rebar_reconciler loggers, _clear_reviewbot_log_handlers NOTSET reset) are hardening follow-ups, not this defect: the guard fails closed on ANY rebar-logger poisoning regardless of source.
